comparison: Exact retained node operands, ordered operation spellings, literal/kwargs and result type/shape/stride/layout, recursively over a bounded diagnostic operation vocabulary. No reassociation, value sampling, module-name or ordinal selector.
limits: Runtime effects and aliasing are not proved by this diagnostic.
Compiler retention, current emitted duplicate loops and source-stage correspondence require separate binding.
Duplicate FX nodes are candidates, not a speedup or a host/device coverage percentage.
Differing quantization dtypes, constants, policy, source epoch or rounding boundaries cannot share.
